newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH M2 JAN MONEY SUPPLY RISES 8.4 PCT-CNB.
newsitem.headline: CZECH M2 JAN MONEY SUPPLY RISES 8.4 PCT-CNB.

text.p: Czech M2 money supply rose 8.4
percent in January year-on-year excluding SPT Telecom deposits
versus 9.2 percent in December, the Czech National Bank said
(CNB) in a statement on Tuesday.
The CNB said that including the large deposits involved in
the equity expansion of SPT, the M2 money supply rose 7.1
percent in January versus 7.8 percent in December.
The CNB said the total volume of crown and foreign currency
denominated loans at the end of January was up 9.6 percent,
year-on-year, up from 10.6 percent in December.
Total end-January deposits, including SPT, were up 6.4
percent, down from 7.1 percent year-on-year growth in December.
